scripts.build: npm install --prefix api && npm run build --prefix api && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('api/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('api/node_modules', 'node_modules', {recursive:true});"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/app.js')) require('./dist/app.js'); else if (fs.existsSync('api/dist/app.js')) require('./api/dist/app.js'); else throw new Error('No dist/app.js found');"
